name: Camping 101: Mining

angles.text: As a miner, you can put your gathering craft to work in the wild by preparing a lodestone for an expedition camp.
As a tauren, you can learn from Brek Stonehoof atop Thunder Bluff's mesas, drawing on tauren knowledge of stone and earthcraft.
As a member of the Horde, you can give those resting by your campfire a lodestone's strength for battles ahead.

faq.answer: A lodestone set beside a campfire lends vigor and combat strength to those gathered there.
faq.q: What does the lodestone do for a campsite?

faq.answer: Brek Stonehoof lives in Thunder Bluff, the tauren capital. He teaches skilled miners to make camping tools from stone and ore.
A miner must first show skill in the trade before Brek Stonehoof teaches the craft of shaping a lodestone.
faq.q: When can a miner learn how to craft a lodestone?

faq.answer: Anyone preparing to wield a weapon can benefit from the lodestone's strength while resting beside it.
faq.q: Who benefits most from a miner's lodestone?

faq.answer: Mining provides metal for smelters and blacksmiths, and lets travelers shape stone tools like lodestones to strengthen a wilderness camp.
faq.q: How does mining tie into establishing a campsite?

faq.answer: In Thunder Bluff, aspiring miners can learn from Brek Stonehoof to make field tools for survival in the wild.
faq.q: What is the purpose of Camping 101: Mining?

sections.body: Mining may lack the glamour of high arcana, but it is honest work found across Azeroth. Miners draw useful minerals and dense stone from deep rock faces. Those materials make weapons and armor, and now they serve a purpose in the field. A miner can shape stone into sturdy tools for a wilderness camp.
sections.title: Honest Labor in the Earth

sections.body: Brek Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff teaches miners to put their trade to use in the wild. Once they show skill with a pick, he teaches them to shape a camp lodestone. Set beside an open blaze, the stone lends vigor and an edge in battle to those preparing to wield a blade.
sections.title: The Lodestone of Thunder Bluff

summary: In Thunder Bluff, miners can learn to carry their craft into the wild. Brek Stonehoof teaches them to shape a lodestone that gives strength to those resting by a campfire.
